mapper.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, PRODUCT_NAME AS name, BRAND_NAME AS brandName, PRICE AS price, STOCK_QUANTITY AS stockQuantity, DESCRIPTION AS description, STATUS AS status, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl FROM PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'STOP' ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC

SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, PRODUCT_NAME AS name, BRAND_NAME AS brandName, PRICE AS price, STOCK_QUANTITY AS stockQuantity, DESCRIPTION AS description, STATUS AS status, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl FROM PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'STOP'
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS name, PRICE AS price, CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'SALE' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS name, STOCK_QUANTITY AS stockQuantity, PRICE AS price FROM PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'SALE' AND STOCK_QUANTITY < 5 ORDER BY STOCK_QUANTITY ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_ID, CATEGORY_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, BRAND_NAME, PRICE, STOCK_QUANTITY, DESCRIPTION, STATUS, IMAGE_URL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{brandName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price}, #{stockQuantity}, #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, 'SALE', #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}, PRODUCT_NAME = #{name}, BRAND_NAME = #{brandName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PRICE = #{price}, STOCK_QUANTITY = #{stockQuantity}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, IMAGE_URL = #{imageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STATUS = #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
UPDATE PRODUCT SET STATUS = 'STOP', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
UPDATE PRODUCT SET STATUS = CASE WHEN STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' ELSE 'SALE' END, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
